description: AI Personalized Portraits MVP - Upload photo, select style, pay, receive AI-generated portrait

userStories.title: Initialize TanStack Start project
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to scaffold the project with TanStack Start CLI so that we have the base structure.
acceptanceCriteria: Run 'npm create @tanstack/start@latest' to create muse-frame project
Install core dependencies: drizzle-orm, stripe, resend, @aws-sdk/client-s3
Dev server starts successfully with 'npm run dev'

userStories.title: Setup database schema with Drizzle
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to define the orders table schema so that we can store order data.
acceptanceCriteria: Orders table has: id, email, style, status (pending|paid|generating|complete|failed|refunded), stripeSessionId, uploadPath, outputPath, regenerationUsed (boolean), createdAt, updatedAt

userStories.title: Create styles configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to define the style catalog so that styles are centrally managed.
acceptanceCriteria: Each style has: id, name, description, category (girls|boys|unisex), price, previewImage, promptTemplate
Include styles: Princess, Fantasy (girls), Superheroes, Fantasy (boys), National Culture, Pre-school Graduation (unisex)

userStories.title: Create landing page with style grid
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to see available portrait styles with previews so that I can choose one.
acceptanceCriteria: Display hero section with value proposition
Show style grid organized by category (Girls, Boys, Unisex)
Each style card shows: preview image, name, description, price
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Create upload page UI
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see an upload form so that I can submit my photo.
acceptanceCriteria: Read style from URL query param, redirect to / if missing
Show selected style info at top
Show photo requirements: JPEG/PNG, max 10MB, single face, clear photo
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Implement photo upload server function
userStories.description: As a system, I need to handle photo uploads and store them in R2.
acceptanceCriteria: Create server function uploadPhoto in lib/server/upload.ts

userStories.title: Add face detection validation
userStories.description: As a system, I need to validate that uploaded photos contain exactly one face.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect faces in uploaded image on client-side
Show error if no face detected
Show error if multiple faces detected
Only enable continue button when validation passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Create Stripe checkout session
userStories.description: As a system, I need to create Stripe checkout sessions for payments.
acceptanceCriteria: Create server function createCheckout in lib/server/stripe.ts
Accept styleId, uploadPath, and email as parameters
Create Stripe Checkout session with correct price

userStories.title: Integrate checkout on upload page
userStories.description: As a user, I want to proceed to payment after uploading my photo.
acceptanceCriteria: Add email input field on upload page
Continue button calls createCheckout server function
Redirect to Stripe Checkout URL on success
Show loading state during checkout creation
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Handle Stripe webhook
userStories.description: As a system, I need to process Stripe webhook events to update order status.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify webhook signature with Stripe secret

userStories.title: Create order status page
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my order status so that I know when my portrait is ready.
acceptanceCriteria: Fetch order by ID from database
Display current status with visual indicator
Show progress steps: Payment → Generating → Complete
Auto-refresh status every 5 seconds while generating
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Create Modal AI generation function
userStories.description: As a system, I need to generate portraits using Modal serverless GPU.
acceptanceCriteria: Accept uploadPath and promptTemplate as parameters
Call Modal API with Stable Diffusion/FLUX model
Handle errors and timeouts (5 min max)

userStories.title: Implement generation job queue
userStories.description: As a system, I need to queue and process generation jobs asynchronously.
acceptanceCriteria: Queue job when order status changes to 'paid'
Update order status to 'generating' when job starts
Update order status to 'complete' with outputPath on success
Update order status to 'failed' on error

userStories.title: Send delivery email with Resend
userStories.description: As a user, I want to receive my portrait via email when generation is complete.
acceptanceCriteria: Use Resend API to send email
Email contains order details and style name
Email contains secure download link (signed R2 URL)
Trigger email send when order status changes to 'complete'

userStories.title: Display download link on status page
userStories.description: As a user, I want to download my portrait directly from the status page.
acceptanceCriteria: Show download button when order status is 'complete'
Generate signed R2 URL for download
Download button opens image in new tab or triggers download
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Implement regeneration feature
userStories.description: As a user, I want to regenerate my portrait once if unsatisfied.
acceptanceCriteria: Show 'Regenerate' button on status page when complete and not used
Button disabled if regenerationUsed is true
Update regenerationUsed to true in database
Send new email with updated download link
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Create admin authentication
userStories.description: As an admin, I need to authenticate to access the admin dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Redirect to login if not authenticated
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Create admin orders list
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to view all orders so that I can monitor the system.
acceptanceCriteria: List all orders with: ID, email, style, status, created date
Add status filter dropdown (All, Pending, Paid, Generating, Complete, Failed)
Show total count and success rate percentage
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Implement admin retry function
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to retry failed generations.
acceptanceCriteria: Show 'Retry' button for orders with status 'failed'
Create server function retryGeneration in lib/server/admin.ts

userStories.title: Implement admin refund function
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to trigger manual refunds via Stripe.
acceptanceCriteria: Show 'Refund' button for orders with status 'paid' or 'failed'
Create server function refundOrder in lib/server/admin.ts
Call Stripe Refund API with payment intent
Log refund action with timestamp and reason

userStories.title: Implement photo cleanup job
userStories.description: As a system, I need to delete uploaded photos after 7 days for privacy.
acceptanceCriteria: Query orders with uploads older than 7 days
Delete original upload files from R2
Create API route /api/cron/cleanup for scheduled invocation
